newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan says no grain tender this week.
newsitem.headline: Japan says no grain tender this week.

text.p: The Food Agency of Japan said on Thursday it did not carry out its import tender for wheat and barley this week.

"This is to adjust our import schedule later this year, and has nothing to do with current grain prices," a Food Agency official said. The agency, which is the grain trading arm of the Agriculture Ministry, normally carries out a grain import tender every Thursday afternoon.
